'''Veet''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] who served in the rank of [[Lieutenant/Legends|lieutenant]] in the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Imperial]] [[Imperial Military (Sith Empire)|Military]] during the [[Galactic War]].

==Biography==
In [[3640 BBY]],<ref name="Time">{{TOR_dates|4}}</ref> Veet led a squad on a mission to take over a [[Drall/Legends|Drall]] weapons factory during the Empire's [[Battle of Corellia|invasion]] on [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]]. When [[Aerowynn]] resisted his attempts, Veet ordered his execution and allowed the Imperial hero to successfully take control of the explosive mines and munitions stored in the factory.<ref name="TOR" />
